details.label: Summary
details.text: Isolated gusty winds may accompany showers and thunderstorms over the next couple of hours across portions of central PA southwestward into northern WV and western MD. Severe potential may increase later this afternoon into early evening toward southern NY and the DelMarVa vicinity

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Convection is gradually increasing in intensity across western PA early this afternoon along/just ahead of a surface cold front. Downstream, stronger heating is occurring within a corridor of scattered to broken cloudiness across central PA into adjacent portions of WV/western MD. Temperatures have warmed into the 70s where this stronger heating has occurred, and weak destabilization is underway. While instability and lapse rates are expected to remain rather mild, strong deep-layer flow will support transient organized bowing structures, and strong gusts at the surface will be possible where more substantial heating occurs. Uncertainty exists with north and east extent across the Mid-Atlantic/Southern New England given persistent stratus and more muted heating. Convective trends are being monitored for possible watch issuance
